No. 1 of 2026
AN ACT to amend the Public Procurement Act, Cap. 15.10.
[ 19th February, 2026 ]
BE IT ENACTED by the King’s Most Excellent Majesty, by
and with the advice and consent of the House of Assembly and the
Senate of Saint Lucia, and by the authority of the same, as follows:

4
No. 1 ] Public Procurement (Amendment) Act [ 2026
Short title
1. This Act may be cited as the Public Procurement (Amendment)
Act, 2026.
Interpretation
2. In this Act, “principal Act” means the Public Procurement
Act, Cap. 15.10.
Amendment of section 2
3. Section 2 of the principal Act is amended by —
(a) deleting the definition for “accounting officer” and by
substituting the following —
“ “accounting officer” has the meaning assigned under
the Public Finance Management Act, Cap. 15.01;”;
(b) deleting the definition for “Board” and by substituting
the following —
“Board” means —
(a) the Central Public Procurement Board established
under section 11;
(b) in relation to a statutory body, the board under the
enactment which establishes the statutory body;”;
(c) inserting in the correct alphabetical sequence the following
new definition —
“statutory body” has the meaning assigned under the
Public Finance Management Act, Cap. 15.01.”.

5
No. 1 ] Public Procurement (Amendment) Act [ 2026
Insertion of new Part V
4. The principal Act is amended by inserting immediately after
section 111, the following new Part V as follows —
“PART V
STATUTORY BODY
Functions of a statutory body
112.—(1) Notwithstanding this Act and any other enactment,
the Board may approve the public procurement procedures to
be applied in the procurement of goods, works and services
and shall give approval to proceed with the procurement of
the goods, works and services.
(2) After approval of the public procurement procedures and
the procurement under subsection (1), the Board shall approve
the award of the contract.
Signing of contract
112A. A contract awarded under section 112 must be
signed by —
(a) the Chairperson of the Board;
(b) a person delegated by the Board;
(c) where paragraph (a) or (b) does not apply, a
person who is authorized to sign under the enactment
that establishes the statutory body.”.
Passed in the House of Assembly this 3rd day of February, 2026.
CLAUDIUS J. FRANCIS,
Speaker of the House of Assembly.
Passed in the Senate this 10th day of February, 2026.
ALVINA REYNOLDS,
President of the Senate.
